dataset.name: HAM10000 (ISIC Archive)
dataset.sampling: One image per lesion, seeded random sample, balanced by class.

questions.name: malignant
questions.instructions: Is the skin lesion in this image malignant (melanoma, basal cell carcinoma or squamous cell carcinoma) rather than benign (nevus, benign keratosis, dermatofibroma or vascular lesion)? Judge only from what is visible, using dermoscopic criteria such as asymmetry, border irregularity, colour variegation, atypical network, blue-white veil, arborising vessels and ulceration.

questions.name: lesion_type
questions.instructions: Which diagnosis best matches the skin lesion in this image?

choices.description: Squamous cell carcinoma, including Bowen's disease: malignant.
Seborrheic keratosis, solar lentigo or lichen-planus-like keratosis: benign.
Angioma, angiokeratoma, pyogenic granuloma or haemorrhage: benign.
None of the above, or not a skin lesion.

questions.name: is_skin_lesion
questions.instructions: Does this image show a close-up or dermoscopic view of a human skin lesion?
